title: First order is very inexpensive; 2nd order is almost double in price
text: I thought would order this for when my 6-8 year old grandchildren come to visit.  The first kit was reasonably priced and my grandkids loved the different science activities.  I just received the 2nd box and it was almost double in price but contains a lot of "engineering-related activities".  I'll test it with my grandkids and if they give it a thumbs up I may keep the subscription going for another month.
label: positive
